title: Two-Stage Residual Inclusion (TSRI) Estimators — tsri
code: # Two-stage residual inclusion estimator # with second stage logistic regression set.seed(9) n            <- 1000 psi0         <- 0.5 Z            <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.5) X            <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.7*Z + 0.2*(1 - Z)) m0           <- plogis(1 + 0.8*X - 0.39*Z) Y            <- rbinom(n, 1, plogis(psi0*X + log(m0/(1 - m0)))) dat          <- data.frame(Z, X, Y) tsrilogitfit <- tsri(Y ~ X | Z , data = dat, link = "logit") summary(tsrilogitfit) #>  #> Call: #> tsri(formula = Y ~ X | Z, data = dat, link = "logit") #>  #> Second stage model link function: logit  #>  #> Coefficients: #>                    Estimate Std.
